digestRecipe.canonicalization: RFC 8785 (JCS): UTF-8, key-sorted, no whitespace, minimal escaping.
digestRecipe.digest: SHA-256, lowercase hex, over the canonical serialization of the object with every `integrity` member removed.
digestRecipe.fixtureScope: All fixtures use integers and ASCII strings only, so any conformant JCS implementation reproduces the pinned byte strings exactly.
digestRecipe.verification: A runner recomputes the pinned digests before trusting the vectors; a mismatch means the vector bytes were altered and the file must not be used.

caseKinds.schema: Validate `object` against `targetSchema` (draft 2020-12, with sibling schemas from this directory loaded). accept/reject is the structural verdict only; a structurally valid object may still be refused by capabilities.json, including the reserved outputTarget.atomic shape.
caseKinds.stateMachine: Consult state-machines.json. `attemptedTransition` must be refused because no transition leaves the terminal state `fromState`.
caseKinds.adoption: Consult command-envelope semantics. The case pins what a conformant command handler commits or refuses, independent of transport.
caseKinds.changefeed: Consult event-envelope semantics. The case pins duplicate handling, ordering, and deterministic read-model rehydration.
